name: ML-SUPERB
description: ML-SUPERB is a multilingual speech processing benchmark covering 143 languages, evaluating self-supervised learning models on tasks including automatic speech recognition and language identification. It extends the SUPERB benchmark beyond English.
reputation: ML-SUPERB is a widely cited multilingual speech benchmark that has become a standard extension of SUPERB for evaluating self-supervised speech models beyond English.
notes: Includes datasets and reproducible training scripts; evaluates frozen SSL features with shallow downstream models.
